authority.permitted_source: Authenticated VET statewide staffroom > Construction > Shared > Resource Library
authority.access_state: Signed-in read-only inventory using the authenticated SharePoint search index, folder UI and representative Word/PowerPoint Online opening checks
authority.content_limit: Only facts, file titles, program relationships and resource destinations visible within the Resource Library were used.
authority.format_reference_only: Accepted Work Studies two-year master program layout; no Work Studies content imported.

scope.site_job: Authenticated-resource navigator and supplementary planning layer
scope.program_job: One source-aligned whole-course teacher delivery program with option branches
scope.assessment: Orientation and pointers only; controlled instruments, answers, assessor materials, learner evidence and competency decisions excluded
scope.quizzes: No quizzes or interactive knowledge checks built
scope.visual_exception: This is a teacher-only link-and-program navigator. The authorised source material remains inside SharePoint and was not licensed or requested for republication. Adding 30 photographs would require copied, invented or decorative material and would not perform a necessary teacher-learning job.

separation.rule: Do not edit, copy into, route through, share storage with or deploy over the original student/evidence-facing site.
separation.storage: No localStorage, IndexedDB, service worker or learner evidence state

exclusions: Resource Library/temp sharing — retained only in the complete inventory, labelled Archive / superseded check and hidden from the default library view; not curated into task teaching sequences
Resource Library/a. Programs and Resources/Document Library.url — retained only in the complete inventory, labelled Archive / superseded check and hidden by default as a redundant pointer
Controlled assessment instruments, assessor guides, answers and learner/workplace data
Facts from the original Construction supplementary site
Public-web curriculum, training-package, legal or standards claims not present in the authorised Resource Library

known_source_conflicts: Source drafts use different study years (2024, 2025 and 2026) and do not establish a current whole-course calendar.
Source-stated weeks and unit indicative hours are not reconciled into a local timetable.
CPC20120 qualification wording varies and is sometimes printed without the level indicator.
Prerequisite wording/codes vary across task drafts.
Task 7 page 1 lists CPCCVE1011 and CPCCOM1012, while pages 14–15 introduce CPCCCM1011 but map basic-project content.
Task 5 option programs explicitly state no HSC content for their competencies.
The direct-resource layer contains 425 exact path-based Staffroom file links; file currency and approval must still be reconfirmed in the signed-in Staffroom before use.
